PokemonFanClubChairmanDidYouVisitToHearA:
I'm the CHAIRMAN
of the #MON FAN CLUB.

I've raised over
150 #MON.

I'm very fussy
when it comes to #MON.

Did you visit just
to hear about my #MON?
PokemonFanClubChairmanRapidashText:
Good!
Then listen up!

So… my favorite
RAPIDASH…

It… cute… lovely…
smart… unbearably… plus… amazing… oh… you think so?… Too much… wild… beautiful… kindly… love it!

Hug it… when…
sleeping… warm and cuddly… Oh, and… spectacular… ravishing… simply divine… Oops! Look at the time! I've kept you too long!
PokemonFanClubChairmanIWantYouToHaveThis:
Thanks for hearing
me out. I want you to have this!
PokemonFanClubChairmanItsARareCandyText:
It's a RARE CANDY
that makes #MON stronger.

I prefer making my
#MON stronger

by battling, so
you can have it.
